# Shared browser catalogue fixtures

These small tied-date and empty datasets come from the active `orrery-data`
browser-distribution implementation in `winnipeg-v1`, observed 14 September 2026.
They preserve the source rows from `../consumer-v1/` and exercise the separately
versioned browser contract: `latest.json`, hashed index/chunk paths, and header
and notice provenance without whole-file or gzip descriptors.

Producer implementation and publication are still under review. Reconcile these
bytes and the browser contract with its final producer commit before enabling
the live endpoint. The existing complete-bundle v1 fixtures remain independent.
